    return original_equal(self, first, second, *args, **kwargs)
unittest.TestCase.assertEqual = observed_equal
program = unittest.main(module=test_settings, argv=['test_settings', '-v'], exit=False)
r = program.result

'''
try:
    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.resolver-audit-', dir=root))
    for augmented in (False, True):
        for faulty in (False, True):
            label = ('regression' if augmented else 'original') + '-' + ('fault' if faulty else 'correct')
            case = scratch / label
            case.mkdir()
            for name in ('settings.py', 'test_settings.py'):
                shutil.copy2(root / name, case / name)
            if faulty:
                (case / 'settings.py').write_bytes(source.replace(old, b'(overrides, environment)'))
            if augmented:
                (case / 'test_settings.py').write_bytes(tests + addition)
            assert (case / 'test_settings.py').read_bytes() == tests + (addition if augmented else b'')
            (case / 'native_probe.py').write_text(probe)
            print('\\nEXECUTION ' + label, flush=True)
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(case / 'native_probe.py')], cwd=case, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'}, timeout=30)
            print(result.stdout, end='', flush=True)
            print('PROCESS EXIT ' + str(result.returncode), flush=True)
            expected = 1 if augmented and faulty else 0
            assert result.returncode == expected, (label, result.returncode)
finally:
    if scratch is not None:
        shutil.rmtree(scratch)
    after = snapshot()
    assert before == after, 'Project bytes/modes/entries changed'
    print('\\nCLEANUP verified: owned scratch removed; all original project file bytes/modes and entries, including Git HEAD/index, unchanged.', flush=True)
